qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High-touch customer service and strong sales culture have driven UK IT reseller market share gains, but near-zero client switching costs and vendor-controlled commission structures prevent independent pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Asset-light UK IT reseller with impressive sales execution and cash generation, but inherently lacks structural pricing power; margins are determined by vendor rebate structures (Microsoft, Cisco) and client procurement tenders with negligible switching barriers.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins on Gross Invoiced Income remain tight at ~5.4-5.5%. While accounting ROCE appears high due to an asset-light balance sheet and working capital terms, the business model is an intermediary price-taker vulnerable to vendor margin squeezes and direct cloud marketplace purchasing.
